title: "Give Us Room, That We May Dwell,"
description: "Give Us Room, That We May Dwell," in Tonic Solfa to ST. BEES, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 291 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Fulness of the Gentiles”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. BEES; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: "Give us room, that we may dwell," Zi-on's child-ren cry a-loud: See their num-bers how they swell! How they ga-ther like a cloud!

lines: "Give us room, that we may dwell,"
See their numbers how they swell!
How they gather like a cloud!
O, how bright the morning seems!
Brighter from so dark a night:
Zion is like one that dreams,
Lo! thy sun goes down no more:
God himself will be thy light:
All that caused thee grief before
Lo! thy light from heaven is come
These that crowd from far are thine;
Give thy sons and daughters room.
